genes.name: wichmann_init
genes.hypothesis: Starting from Wichmann's complete ruler (ratio about 3) instead of a block plus its multiples (ratio about 4) saves the annealing the climb from 4 to 3, which is most of what a short budget is spent on.
genes.predicted: large gain at short budgets and large n (-0.3 to -0.8 in score at n = 64, 5 s); shrinking at long budgets
genes.author: seed

genes.name: hole_directed
genes.hypothesis: Near the target only a few distances are missing; moving a mark to x_j +- d for a missing distance d creates that distance for certain, while a uniform position almost never does, so directed proposals close holes far faster.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: restart_from_best
genes.hypothesis: At a fixed temperature the walk can drift far from the last covering set into a region with many holes; returning to the best set with a small random kick after a long stall keeps the search near good sets.
genes.predicted: small gain (about -0.02) at long budgets; nothing at short ones, where a stall of stall_iters moves rarely happens
genes.author: seed

genes.name: temp
genes.hypothesis: Annealing temperature in units of uncovered distances: a move that opens one more hole is accepted with probability exp(-1/temp). Too cold and the walk freezes in a local optimum, too hot and it never closes the last hole.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: width_factor
genes.hypothesis: Marks may sit anywhere in 0..width_factor * T. The best sets stick out beyond v (the published 360-set reaches 1.12 v), so a window above 1 helps, but a wide window wastes most proposals on useless far positions.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: hole_prob
genes.hypothesis: Share of proposals aimed at a missing distance; the rest stay uniform so that the walk can still leave a basin.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: stall_iters
genes.hypothesis: Proposals without a new best set before returning to the best one. Too short and the walk never gets far enough to find a new covering set.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: kick_size
genes.hypothesis: Marks moved at random after a return to the best set, so that the walk does not retrace its previous path.
genes.author: seed
